title: What God Has Joined
description: Why does an old story still speak so clearly to us today?
This week we open Mark 10:1–12 and ask what the passage is really saying, before we ask what it means for us.
We notice how the passage fits into the larger story of The Servant King, and what has come just before it.
Along the way we meet some familiar excuses, and some better reasons to hope.
We finish with a few simple questions to take home and talk over with a friend this week.
